about: The two programs run in wkhtmltopdf's place. wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 is fixed; for marqius-wkhtmltopdf, each run tests the version it is given or the latest, and files the version it used with its results. 'attestations': the GitHub repository whose provenance attestation, when one exists for a file's digest, must verify before the file is tested.

programs.name: wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6
programs.how: upstream's own package for Ubuntu 22.04 (wkhtmltopdf/packaging 0.12.6.1-3, patched Qt), the newest it made, installed with apt

programs.name: marqius-wkhtmltopdf
programs.how: its one-line installer, given the version, from a copy of marqius.com's files checked against their SHA-256
